verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs confirm it offers external status pages, including a FireHydrant-hosted option alongside Atlassian Statuspage, so the core of a hosted public status page is its own capability. Incident updates posted via Slack (`/fh update`) or Command Center are documented as flowing only to the internal per-incident status page; the link to external pages is implied, not shown. missing for 10: evidence of custom domain support, subscriber notifications (email/SMS subscriptions), explicit documentation that external pages update from incident state, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
